name: grok-bitch
description: A Rick & Morty multi-agent orchestrator for Claude Code, built on a deterministic safety-cage DISCIPLINE. Offload mechanical, verifiable grunt work to Morty — a bounded, untrusted-by-default Claude subagent that his handler independently verifies (never trusts his word), keeping the noisy transcript out of your context. Claude keeps the rigor; Morty does the bitch work. The cage is now a discipline the cast runs under — bounded scope, guard+revert on protected paths, a verify gate, never self-certify, hand back if a step is too big, never push on its own — not an external binary. (Earlier versions shelled out to a caged grok/grok-build model through a CLI; grok and that CLI have been retired — the plugin is pure Claude now.) Ships auto-invoked skills (so Claude reaches for them), a 20-strong persona cast of subagents (Rick the 300-IQ handler, Morty the grunt executor, Mr. Meeseeks, Jerry, Citadel Rick, Beth, Space Beth, Summer, Birdperson, Mr. Poopybutthole, Evil Morty the directed red-teamer, Randotron the seeded-chaos fuzzer, Council Rick the consensus-triangulator, Mr. President the release authority, Snowball the escalation reasoner, Dr. Xenon Bloom the architecture cartographer, Jessica the UX reviewer, Diane the archivist, Butter Robot the YAGNI gate, Noob-Noob the maintenance runner — each with show-accurate skills and a style-accurate model tier), three session modes (/rick-mode to become Rick, /adventure-mode to run a goal as a multi-agent Workflow, /family-mode for a standing ensemble) plus a darker /rick-mode variant (/detox, keeping the Toxic Rick half), and augmentations and one-shot commands (/auto-rick, /episode, /rick-git, /council, /jerry-test the inverted Jerry-as-legibility-gauge, /jerry-swarm the disposable-horde swarm of a broad front, /cronenberg, /pickle-rick, /blips-n-chitz, /commentary the default-on in-voice code-comment track, and /explicit the opt-in profanity layer that pulls the Adult Swim censor bleep so Rick swears on the beats that earn it — off by default, a light/show/heavy dial the /detox variant turns up, with hard guardrails no dial moves: never slurs, tease-not-abuse, facts and machine tokens stay exact, and the profanity lives in the live session, never in commits/comments/docs). Two personas double as spawnable agents — toxic-rick (the harder-driving handler with the token-economy bias to actually offload to Morty) and pickle-rick (a solo minimal-footprint doer) — the agent forms of /detox and /pickle-rick. The cast's truth-finding is formally backed by the bundled Aletheia Method and its Interferometry instruments — a triangulation discipline (Council Rick = the Trilateration Protocol; Citadel Ricks = independent blind bearings; Evil Morty/Randotron = the discriminating probe) with five deterministic, dependency-free Python instruments and a claim Ledger. Rick's reasoning stack is further hardened by a field-tested Robustness Doctrine mined from Voyager, Apollo, and SpaceX — a cost-of-failure dial, a silence-triggered dead-man timer on delegated work, an affirmative roll-call before irreversible moves, and a mandatory dissent channel carried across the cast. As of 2.2.0 the certification discipline has deterministic teeth: one typed-label ledger grammar shared across the cast (Verified[route-A|route-B] and friends, with all-LLM agreement capped at Observed), a machine-readable `outcome` block that rides as a six-line footer UNDER each load-bearing report (the machine gets its own lines so the prose stays free), and a zero-dependency `label_lint.py` — a non-LLM oracle for the cast's own claim class — wired as a non-blocking SubagentStop hook that warns on a manufactured `Verified` or a `done` with no green verify, and never blocks. The voice is paint; the rigor underneath is surgical — maniac in the prose, surgeon in the facts.
